data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 54–55):** **`لِـ`** ka matlab **'ke liye'** hai. Iske baad aane wale ism ke neeche **Zair (`ـِ / ـٍ`)** aa jati hai, aur agar lafz ke shuru mein `الْـ` ho toh milate waqt Alif (`ا`) gir jata hai: `الْكِتَابُ ← لِلْكِتَابِ`، `اللَّهُ ← لِلَّهِ`.

data.text: Upar di gayi misaalon se wazeh hai ke 'Li' (لِـ) ka matlab 'ke liye' hai. Iske baad aane wale ism par zair (kasrah) aati hai. 'Li' aur iske baad aane wala lafz milkar ek murakkab banaate hain, iss liye unka tarjuma ek saath hota hai. Agar jumle ke aakhir mein kuch nahi toh 'hai' ka izaafa karein.
